parsed.notes:
QUALIFICATIONS defaults to required; NICE TO HAVE makes its items optional. Technologies appearing only in the introduction or responsibilities were excluded.
Group 1 represents the qualification accepting one or more of LLM post-training, reinforcement learning, search and retrieval, or agent systems; search and retrieval has no matching taxonomy entry.
LLMs is explicitly named within LLM post-training. Post-training itself is left unmapped rather than equated with fine-tuning.
Generic retrieval is not assumed to mean RAG or vector search; agent harnesses are not assumed to mean agent architecture; scalable inference infrastructure is not assumed to mean inference optimization.
The optional alternatives involving agent harnesses/distributed training/inference infrastructure and retrieval/ranking/recommendation each have only one mapped member, so no additional groups are emitted.
Seniority follows the literal rule that Staff in a title indicates senior, but is flagged because Member of Technical Staff can be a level-neutral title.
